subject: Proposed demo rota + pick video room and attendee confirmation
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Joshi <s.joshi@medalign.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medalign.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed demo rota + pick video room and attendee confirmation

Hi Samir / Liam —

Thanks again for taking time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery: MedAlign is evaluating an inference platform to reduce per-token cost on clinical summarization and to get predictable latency for API calls across your cloud regions. Next step: a 45-minute technical walkthrough where we show the model serving flow, KV cache behavior for long patient notes, and runtime profiling for your throughput targets.

Two windows we can host this week (all PT):
- Option A: Thu Jul 20, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Option B: Fri Jul 21, 14:00–14:45 PT

A couple of asks so we can send a calendar invite and the right bridge:
1) Please confirm which slot (A or B) works best.
2) Confirm final attendee list and roles — we recommend product + eng + security (if possible).
3) Do you prefer Zoom or Google Meet for the session? We can provide a breakout-ready Zoom room if you need shared screens between multiple presenters.

We also have a short agenda attached (demo-agenda.pdf). If you confirm slot and attendees, Karthik will host and Marissa will join for ops questions. We plan a 5–10 minute Q&A at the end and a short mutual action plan to capture next steps.

Thanks — I can lock the invite as soon as you confirm the time.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett | Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Laura —

Appreciate the clear recap. Both windows look doable for our team; if we have to pick one, Option B (Fri 21, 14:00 PT) is slightly better for our UK engineering lead to join.

Planned attendees from MedAlign:
- Samir Joshi (Director, ML) — me
- Liam O'Connor (Staff SW Eng)
- Priya Shah (Security Architect) — tentative

We'd prefer Zoom so we can record and distribute internally. Two quick notes:
- Priya may confirm later today; if she can't make it, we'll send security questions in advance.
- Can you include a short security checklist/slide during the demo (data residency, audit logs, SOC2 evidence pointers)? That helps speed IT review.

If you can lock Option B and share the bridge, we'll confirm attendees by EOD. Thanks!

—Samir
